name: EPIC 211309965
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 7.8 solar radii and 1.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211309965 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.797355 (16th-84th percentiles 7.513849-8.09809), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211309965 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.145648 (16th-84th percentiles 1.048443-1.254058), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211309965: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4871.666 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211309965 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3989.882812 (16th-84th percentiles 3874.375-4110.546875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,990 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.15 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,872 K at its surface.
